name: dojo-brief
description: Lints every subagent brief at dispatch against the delegate skill: detail, owned files, done-check, return shape. A notice, or one send-back.

lint_briefs.title: Lint briefs (mod)
lint_briefs.description: Mod only: lint each subagent brief at dispatch. false turns the lint off; /dojo-brief still inserts the template.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to do with a thin subagent brief: notice (default) logs one dim line, sendback refuses the first dispatch with a missing field once, off passes everything.

min_chars.title: Minimum brief length
min_chars.description: A prompt shorter than this many characters is flagged as thin.
